Package gov.cdc.izgateway.service.impl

Class EndpointStatusService

java.lang.Object
gov.cdc.izgateway.service.impl.EndpointStatusService
@Service public class EndpointStatusService extends Object
The EndpointStatusService enables management to a stored cache of endpoint statuses for each destination accessible by the given host.
